Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: final square 1:1 1024x1024 or larger Roblox experience icon for Pump a Balloon to Space. Create a striking polished cheerful stylized 3D game illustration, bright blue sky and puffy white clouds transitioning to a small violet starry outer-space corner. A friendly Roblox-inspired block-shaped avatar, yellow skin, short brown hair, bright cyan shirt, smiling with wonder, is at the bottom left actively holding the T-handle of a small sky-blue air pump. Its thick blue hose visibly connects to a huge glossy coral-red party balloon that dominates the upper center and right, with a small golden curly ribbon, with upward movement suggested by two clean speed streaks. Tiny simple floating green launch pad ground beneath the pump. Composition: one big balloon + one expressive block avatar + one readable pump, oversized silhouettes, very uncluttered, strong navy shadows, cream highlights, warm coral versus saturated sky cyan contrast. Avatar and main balloon comfortably inside central safe area so circular crops remain recognizable; full image square edge to edge, opaque background. Clearly represents pumping balloons to space, not weapons or pets. No text, logo, letters, numbers, UI, border, watermark, prizes, free Robux or gamepasses. Needs to remain recognizable at 150x150 and 64x64. No photorealistic human or fingers, no inflated muscular body, no crowded collage.
